newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.176 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton output reaches 7.176 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's 1996/97 (July-June) cotton output reached 7.176 million 375-lb bales in the week ended December 26 compared to 7.313 million in the year-ago period, the state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said on Saturday.
Ginners had sold 5.301 million bales to textile mills compared to 5.063 million a year-ago, the Corporation said in its weekly statistics.
Some 1.873 million bales remained in the ginneries as unsold stocks, it said.
Revised estimates put the crop between 8.5 and 8.7 million bales, sharply lower than the target of 10 million bales.
Pakistan produced 9.94 million bales of cotton in the 1995/96 season.
